summary.en:
- Himeko is a DPS unit who primarily deals damage through her Follow-UP ATKs.
- When normal enemies or Elite enemies become Weakness Broken, Himeko gains one or three point(s) of Charge respectively, up to a max of 3 points of Charge. Upon reaching 3 points of Charge, she unleashes a Follow-Up ATK that deals damage to all enemies.
- Himeko excels in content where enemies can be frequently Weakness Broken, such as Pure Fiction.
- Despite Himeko having CRIT traces, her damage nowadays is underwhelming, unlike her Toughness damage, making her a viable Break carry.
- Himeko's performance is reliant on Dahlia and Fugue for charge generation and consistent Super Break DMG.

details.en:
- E1 increases her [[stat:spd]] after triggering her Talent.
- S1 [[light-cone:milky-way]] increases her own [[stat:atk]], and boosts her DMG after enemies are inflicted with Weakness Break for 1 turn. This is not impactful for Break DMG.
